Extended Coverage · Quick Response

Extended Coverage Quick Response Sprinklers

A 3 mm glass bulb sprinkler family available in pendent, upright and horizontal sidewall configurations. The current range is DN20 / ¾ in, K8.0 US / K115 metric and 68°C / 155°F.
